newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $112/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $112/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade was modest on Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers mostly steady with last Wednesday on a dressed basis when last sales volume large enough for comparison, live prices not established.

Buyer inquiry improving as the day progressed and bids improved. However, sellers still firm in their offers. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).

Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1100 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1300 lbs 110.00-112.00, "calf-feds" mostly 110.00; yearlings 111.00-112.00. ( weighted average 110.96 ).

Slaughter heifers - Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 110.00-112.00, "calf-feds" mostly 110.00; yearlings 111.00-112.00. (weighted average 111.00). Confirmed - 3,800 Last Week - 63,900 Last Year - 1,900 For The Week- 7,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 68,300 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 4,900
